content: Apple has just released iOS 27.2, bringing Apple Pencil support to the iPhone Duo. The software update also includes an “Edge Light” feature for the iPhone Duo that’s intended to illuminate your face during video calls. Apple previously said the iPhone Duo would add support for the Apple Pencil “later this year.” The company’s first foldable comes with revamped iOS 27 controls designed to work across the device’s 7.6-inch inner display and 5.4-inch outer screen. Many major apps, like Netflix, Prime Video, and Microsoft Outlook, already support the Duo’s extra screen real estate, but some still need some work. The iOS 27.2 update also allows Siri AI to take suggested actions in Messages, while adding support for Siri AI in more languages, including French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish. Apple is rolling out support for Google’s SynthID AI watermark in Photos and Image Playground, too, according to 9to5Mac. Other smaller but notable updates include user profiles on the Apple TV app on iPhone. The Apple Podcasts app is also replacing its “Up Next” queue with a list of “New Episodes,” along with a “Continue Playing” section just beneath it. You’ll also see the new Apple Music logo. And group calls on FaceTime now support dual capture so you can show both what’s visible from your selfie cam and your back cameras. Apple also released macOS 27.2 Golden Gate, watchOS 27.2, visionOS 27.2, tvOS 27.2, and HomePod 27.2.

chineseContent: Apple 刚刚发布了 iOS 27.2，为 iPhone Duo 带来了 Apple Pencil 支持。软件更新还包括 iPhone Duo 的“Edge Light”功能，旨在在视频通话期间照亮您的脸部。苹果此前表示，iPhone Duo 将在“今年晚些时候”增加对 Apple Pencil 的支持。该公司的首款可折叠设备配备了改进的 iOS 27 控件，旨在在设备的 7.6 英寸内部显示屏和 5.4 英寸外部屏幕上运行。许多主要应用程序，如 Netflix、Prime Video 和 Microsoft Outlook，已经支持 Duo 的额外屏幕空间，但有些应用程序仍需要一些改进。 iOS 27.2 更新还允许 Siri AI 在消息中执行建议操作，同时增加了对更多语言的 Siri AI 支持，包括法语、日语、韩语、葡萄牙语和西班牙语。据 9to5Mac 报道，苹果也在 Photos and Image Playground 中推出了对 Google SynthID AI 水印的支持。其他较小但值得注意的更新包括 iPhone 上 Apple TV 应用程序的用户配置文件。苹果播客应用程序还将其“上一个”队列替换为“新剧集”列表，以及其下方的“继续播放”部分。您还会看到新的 Apple Music 徽标。 FaceTime 上的群组通话现在支持双捕捉，因此您可以同时显示自拍摄像头和后置摄像头的可见内容。苹果还发布了 macOS 27.2 Golden Gate、watchOS 27.2、visionOS 27.2、tvOS 27.2 和 HomePod 27.2。
